% =====================================================================
%  CV — Harvard-style with subtle orange accent from the portfolio.
%  Single column, A4, no photo, one page. UPPERCASE headings with
%  orange rule beneath. Dates right-aligned.
%
%  Generated by backend/scripts/generate-cv.ts from resume.json.
% =====================================================================

\documentclass[10pt]{article}

% Tight margins so typical content (3 projects, 1 job, 1 education,
% ~7 skill groups, languages) fits on a single Harvard-style page.
% If much more content is added later, the CV will naturally extend.
\usepackage[a4paper, top=1.2cm, bottom=1.2cm, left=1.3cm, right=1.3cm]{geometry}
\usepackage{fontspec}
% Lato: modern sans with multiple weights. Requires the `fonts-lato` package
% in the system (apt install fonts-lato on Ubuntu).
\setmainfont{Lato}[
  UprightFont    = *-Regular,
  ItalicFont     = *-Italic,
  BoldFont       = *-Bold,
  BoldItalicFont = *-BoldItalic,
]
\newfontfamily\latolight{Lato}[UprightFont=*-Light]
\newfontfamily\latoblack{Lato}[UprightFont=*-Black]
\setmonofont{DejaVu Sans Mono}

\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage{microtype}
\usepackage{tabularx}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{parskip}

% --- Palette: orthodox Harvard black & white ---
\definecolor{bodytext}{HTML}{1A1A1A}
\definecolor{mutedtext}{HTML}{555555}

\color{bodytext}
\hypersetup{colorlinks=true, urlcolor=bodytext, linkcolor=bodytext}

% --- Harvard-style section: subtle UPPERCASE + thin rule below ---
\newcommand{\cvsection}[1]{%
  \vspace{5pt}%
  {\fontsize{10}{12}\selectfont\bfseries\color{bodytext}\addfontfeature{LetterSpace=6.0}\MakeUppercase{#1}}\par%
  \vspace{3pt}%
  \hrule height 0.4pt%
  \vspace{3pt}%
}

\setlist{itemsep=0pt, topsep=1pt, parsep=0pt, leftmargin=1em}
\pagestyle{empty}
% Slightly tighter line spacing to gain extra lines without losing readability.
\linespread{0.98}

\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.05}

\newcommand{\entry}[4]{%
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}X r@{}}
    \textbf{#1} & \textbf{#3} \\
    \textit{\color{mutedtext}#2} & \textit{\color{mutedtext}#4} \\
  \end{tabularx}
  \vspace{0pt}
}

\begin{document}

% ==================== HEADER ====================
\begin{center}
  {\fontsize{18}{22}\selectfont\latoblack\color{bodytext}{{NAME}}\par}
  \vspace{2pt}
  {\fontsize{10}{12}\selectfont\latolight\color{bodytext}{{LABEL}}\par}
  \vspace{4pt}
  {\fontsize{8.5}{11}\selectfont\color{mutedtext}{{CONTACT_LINE}}\par}
\end{center}

\vspace{3pt}
\hrule height 0.6pt
\vspace{0pt}

% ==================== SUMMARY ====================
\cvsection{Summary}
{{SUMMARY}}

% ==================== EDUCATION ====================
\cvsection{Education}
{{EDUCATION_BLOCK}}

% ==================== EXPERIENCE ====================
\cvsection{Experience}
{{WORK_BLOCK}}

% ==================== SKILLS ====================
\cvsection{Technical skills}
{{SKILLS_BLOCK}}

% ==================== PROJECTS ====================
\cvsection{Selected projects}
{{PROJECTS_BLOCK}}

% ==================== LANGUAGES ====================
\cvsection{Languages}
{{LANGUAGES_BLOCK}}

\end{document}
